info.title: Payment
info.description:
Coins.ph Partner Integration API v2.7

## Authentication
All requests must include the following headers:
- `X-COINS-APIKEY`: Your API key
- `Timestamp`: Unix timestamp of the request
- `Signature`: HMAC-SHA256 signature of the request

Requests and webhook payloads must be signed using HMAC-SHA256 with the API secret.

## Environments
- **Sandbox**: `https://api.9001.pl-qa.coinsxyz.me`
- **Production**: `https://api.pro.coins.ph`

status.description:
Indicates the current state of the order.
- PENDING: The order is still being processed and is not in a final state.
- SUCCEEDED: The order has been successfully processed.
- FAILED: The order processing has failed.
- CANCEL: The order has been canceled by the user and is considered equivalent to a failure.

Only orders in a final state (SUCCEEDED, FAILED, or CANCEL) are considered complete and reliable for further actions. Avoid relying on orders in a non-final state (PENDING) as their status may change.

startDate.description: The order's create time will be between startDate and endDate. Accepts ISO 8601 format (UTC) (e.g., "2016-10-20T13:00:00.000000Z") or a time delta (e.g., "1w 3d 2h 32m 5s").

endDate.description: The order's create time will be between startDate and endDate. Accepts ISO 8601 format (UTC) (e.g., "2016-10-20T13:00:00.000000Z") or a time delta (e.g., "1w 3d 2h 32m 5s").

startTime.description: The order's create time will be between startTime and endTime. Works when both startDate and endDate are empty. The server time zone is UTC+0.

endTime.description: The order's create time will be between startTime and endTime. Works when both startDate and endDate are empty. The server time zone is UTC+0.

post.description:
Create a new virtual account.

**Webhook:** ✅ Supported (requires Coins.ph configuration)

vAccountType.description: Virtual Account Type. `0`: ENTERPRISE type, `1`: PERSONAL type.

vAccountUsage.description: Virtual Account Usage Type. `0`: ONE_TIME, `1`: MULTIPLE.

validityPeriod.description:
Virtual Account Validity Period: Only applies to one-time transaction type. When vAccountUsage is ONE_TIME, validityPeriod is required.
Enumeration Values:
- `D1`: 1 day
- `D2`: 2 days
- `D3`: 3 days
- `D4`: 4 days
- `D5`: 5 days
- `D6`: 6 days
- `D7`: 7 days

cAccountNumber.description: User ID on other platforms (not Coins). Better be unique.

cAccountName.description: User name on other platforms (not Coins).

coinsUserId.description: Required for PERSONAL type. The user's Coins userId (external ID). **Must be passed as a string** to avoid large integer precision loss.

requestId.description: Idempotency key for this creation request.

businessScenario.description:
Business scenario for automatic ramp.
- `AUTO_ON_RAMP`: Fiat in → Crypto out (fiatDestination required)
- `AUTO_OFF_RAMP`: Crypto in → Fiat out (cryptoDestination required)
- `AUTO_RAMP`: Both directions (both destinations required)
- ``: Non-auto scenario (default)

fiatDestination.description: Required when businessScenario is AUTO_ON_RAMP or AUTO_RAMP.

cryptoDestination.description: Required when businessScenario is AUTO_OFF_RAMP or AUTO_RAMP.

needStaticQrCode.description: Whether to generate a QRPH static QR code simultaneously. Defaults to `false`.

extend.description: Extended fields with additional information. Key and value length must not exceed 1000 characters.

fiatSettings.description: Fiat-related settings for the virtual account, including fiat currency types and corresponding channels. At least one of fiatSettings or cryptoSettings must be present.

cryptoSettings.description: Crypto-related settings for the virtual account, including crypto types and corresponding networks. Cannot be set when vAccountUsage is ONE_TIME.
